simulation.task: fix a failing test in the CLI
simulation.rationale: The task is to fix a failing test in the CLI. The three files are skill definitions for unrelated operations (commit/push/pr, deduplication, issue triage). They provide no information about the CLI codebase, test structure, or failure details. Including them would add ~2000 tokens of dead weight with zero relevance.

findings.title: Conflicting Git Tooling Requirements
findings.detail: The commit-push-pr command explicitly allows and requires the use of raw 'gh' and 'git' commands, whereas the dedupe command strictly forbids them in favor of a local wrapper script.

citations.quote: allowed-tools: Bash(git checkout --branch:*), Bash(git add:*), Bash(git status:*), Bash(git push:*), Bash(git commit:*), Bash(gh pr create:*)
- Use `./scripts/gh.sh` to interact with Github, rather than web fetch or raw `gh`.

findings.title: Overlapping Duplicate Issue Detection
findings.detail: Both the 'dedupe' and 'triage-issue' commands are tasked with identifying duplicate GitHub issues using the same underlying search tools, creating ambiguity about which command should be used for duplicate management.

citations.quote: - Check for duplicates with `./scripts/gh.sh search issues`. Only mark as duplicate of OPEN issues.

findings.title: Redundant Tool Documentation
findings.detail: The usage examples and constraints for the `./scripts/gh.sh` wrapper are duplicated across multiple command files, increasing the risk of documentation drift.

citations.quote: - `./scripts/gh.sh issue view 123` — read issue title, body, and labels

findings.title: Conflicting Output Constraints
findings.detail: The commit-push-pr command forbids any text output other than tool calls, while the dedupe command requires the agent to 'Make a todo list first', which would violate the 'no other text' rule if applied globally.

citations.quote: Do not send any other text or messages besides these tool calls.

actions.rationale: Irrelevant to core coding tasks like fixing tests; should be an on-demand skill to resolve git/gh tool usage contradictions.
Folds duplicate issue detection logic into triage-issue.md to resolve overlapping responsibilities and redundant script documentation.
Issue management is not required for local test fixing; moving to on-demand prevents output constraint conflicts and saves significant context.
